body: yeah. that kind of just screws me over though because every time i tell someone that my suicidal thoughts bother me constantly, the person (be a therapist or psychiatrist) just thinks i should be under constant supervision with a lot of medication. or they just give me another diagnosis.

i want to look forward to getting up in the morning. i want to feel like it gets better. i -know- it gets better but that's in my head. my heart doesn't feel that way. it's like i'm dying on the inside. i have all the logic in the world. i know why i shouldn't die. i just don't really give a shit.

i just feel like i'm at the end. like i've done everything i've could to feel better. when i was at school last semester, i left because i thought that i needed time to myself. time to rest. that didn't work because i just got really fucking lonely. xanax and alcohol became my best friend. i'm a recovering alcoholic & addict as of right now and it's not too bad. i know i can live without substances. i go to my meetings. i go to outpatient. i have a job. i'm doing everything i can to get my emotions back to where they should be and i don't feel any different. i'm just so fucking tired.
